title: Static review remote LiteLLM pricing
description: Opt-in, one real Pi review of a tiny local Git fixture through an isolated production gateway, then its receipt re-measured through the remote tmux receipt branch on a node without LiteLLM credentials. Requires a models.json LiteLLM route for the review model in Pi's agent directory, LITELLM_API_KEY accepted by that route, and a new private output directory. Pi gets an isolated home whose models.json routes the review model through a loopback proxy to that route; the launch environment and gateway pricing get another proxy path. Retention and session checks stay in the static review session accounting recipe. No live farm or publication writes.

remote-pricing.cmd: TSX_TSCONFIG_PATH=services/gateway/tsconfig.json FARMSLOT_REVIEW_PROOF_USAGE=1 FARMSLOT_REVIEW_PROOF_REMOTE_PRICING=1 FARMSLOT_REVIEW_PROOF_ROUNDS=1 FARMSLOT_REVIEW_PROOF_RUNNER=pi FARMSLOT_REVIEW_PROOF_MODEL=litellm/deepseek-v4p1-flash FARMSLOT_REVIEW_PROOF_EFFORT=low node --import tsx scripts/runner-validation/gateway/slotless-review-retention.mts "$FARMSLOT_REVIEW_PRICING_PROOF_OUTPUT"
remote-pricing.intent: The launch receipt and run.get keep only the digest of the LiteLLM route the Pi process sent its requests through, not the launch environment's LiteLLM URL, and no part of either URL. Re-measured through the remote tmux receipt branch, the verified route is priced from the gateway list at the local quote, and the launch environment's URL, which Pi did not use, leaves it unpriced with the same token counts.
